correctness.rationale: The local reset clock kills each backward voter lineage at rate r; a union bound on survival back to the start gives convergence for any finite spin set and uniqueness conditional on the template. For the mixed and two-spin functions the stationary generators give (r−Δ/2)H=rC and (2r−Δ)G=2rH off the origin, with G_0=1. I independently solved the mixed recurrence for c≠q in the basis c^n,q^n and applied the odd-reflection Green kernel on the positive half-line: G_1=q+(1−q)^2 sum_{n≥1} q^(n−1)H_n. The convergent limit extends to c=q. Symbolic reduction of this independent expression (/workspace/audit_replay_5.py) gives exactly the asserted rational function, both derivatives and all three specializations c=−1,0,1. For c<0 the q-derivative is positive by the displayed positive-coefficient grouping and 7q²−3q+1>0, and the endpoints are c and 1. The c-derivative is positive on the physical domain by bounding its numerator bracket separately for 3q²≥1 and 3q²<1. Since r decreases with q, this proves a single crossing and the asserted ordering. For c≥0 coalescence before either reset has positive probability and every template pair moment is nonnegative. The cubic root gives r*=1.446156936667017074…; the implicit equation near (q,c)=(0,0) gives q=−c/2+O(c²) and the claimed asymptotic. Uniqueness of the negative c boundary refers to admissible correlations in [−1,0), not to roots of the polynomial over all real c.

value.rationale: The sign reversal quantifies when local resetting overcomes voter alignment for a natural family of spatially anticorrelated memories. The strict ordered boundaries, their sharp lower envelope and its exact checkerboard witness provide a quantitative benchmark more informative than the known i.i.d. correlation. It is a local annealed effect, not a thermodynamic phase transition or a quenched sign theorem.
